summary.text: Daniel Pae is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 62 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Pae took office on November 21, 2018, succeeding John Montgomery.

Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Appropriations and Budget Committee and the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee, and it shows him as chair of the Agriculture & Rural Development Committee in 2023-2024.
Ballotpedia lists Blake Munoz, a Democrat, as his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
